Remark
[orientation of fixed-point-free isometries]

Source: petersen:page-0286 ↗ rem:pet-ch6-closed-parallel-field-construction 1. ch6:6.7.21Let $(M,g)$ be compact with $\sec >0$ and $F:M\to M$ an isometry of finite order without fixed points. Show that if $\dim M$ is even, $F$ is orientation reversing; if odd, orientation preserving. (Weinstein: this holds even without the finite-order hypothesis.)
